contexts.text: A Spirit applied himself to my left side.
The Spirits who rebuked were perceived at the side under the arm. AC 8021.
All that is obscure as to good and truth is called the sides of the earth.
Those at the side, are the gentiles (and their collateral good). Treated of.
Evils and falsities rejected to the sides.
The things which do not agree with the loves are at the sides, and those which do not agree at all are rejected to the ultimate boundaries.
Then all the scientifics which are not congruous... are rejected from the middle to the sides; thus from the light which is in the middle to the shades which are at the sides.
The things not directly under the view are... at the sides.
His side to Sidon () = extension on the one side to the Knowledges of good and truth. AE 447:3. AE 514:17.
Any things they do not apprehend, they reject to the sides.
(With such) the scientifics which confirm good and truth are rejected to the sides.
Places at the sides under the soles.
Then truths and goods not genuine are rejected to the sides. Signified.
They remain adjoined at the side.
With the good, evil and falsity are rejected to the sides.
A great nation from the sides of the earth () = those who are in evils entirely opposite to good.
The sides of the earth () = where falsities from evil break out.
The sides of the earth from which they will be gathered () = where the truth and good of the Church begin; for the earth = the Church; and its sides are where are its first and its last.
With side and shoulder = with all force and power.
Truths then depart to the sides, and make the circuit.
(The lunar Spirit who had been carried) applied himself to my left side under the elbow, and spoke thence.
Under Ring, see this reference.
The side = good which is to be conjoined with truth, and the derivative power.
The sides (of the ark) relate to the thoracic part in man.

Upon the sides of the ark () = in ultimates; for the sides of the ark = the Divine sphere which encompasses Heaven in ultimates; for the sides are the terminations, (which) in Heaven have no relation to spaces, but to goods conjoined with truths...

Three reeds of the candlestick from its one side, and three... from its other side () = what is full as to good and truth... From the one side and from the other side = from good and the derivative truth; for the things on the right side of the body = goods, and those on the left side the truths thence; for instance, the right and left sides of the face.
The side of the Habitation () = the quarter of Heaven whither the look is directed. Explained.

The staves on the two sides of the altar () = the power of the good from which is truth, and of the truth from which is good. The two sides = good from truth and truth from good, thus the marriage of good with truth and of truth with good; because the things on the right side with man relate to good from which is truth, and those on the left side, to truth from good; for all the representatives in nature relate to the human form.
The belly and side () = the third state of the Church.
The walls, or sides = interiors... For the sides and breast with man = interiors.
The sides, which are called ribs (), regard the south and north... but by sides, properly called sides, is signified good, because they regard the west and east. AC 10190.
At the right and left sides sit those in less light of wisdom.
Their piercing His side = that they had completely extinguished all the truth and good of the Word. TCR 130:end.
He then relegates his fallacies to the sides.
All things remain, and, when remitted after repentance, are moved out to the sides; and then... the things at the sides appear in shade, and sometimes in darkness.
Still, evils... are only removed to the sides.
If good conquers, evil with its falsity is removed to the sides... If evil conquers, good with its truth is removed to the sides.
Celibates are at the side of Heaven. Explained.
Merely natural Spirits become frigid when they apply themselves to the side of any Angel who is in a state of love.

The sides of the earth = the things outside the Church; thus evils remote from the goods of the Church. AE 275:15. ( = where are the ultimates of the Church, and where evils and falsities begin. AE 304:20.) ( = whence are evils; for the sides of the earth = what is remote from goods. AE 355:19.) ( = such ultimate truths. AE 721:10.)

His side pierced, and blood and water coming out () = the conjunction of the Lord with the human race through the Divine truth proceeding from the Divine good of His love. For the breast = the Divine love; and blood and water, the Divine truth proceeding.
The side at which a thousand shall fall () = good.
The sides of the north () = what is remote from goods and truths, thus whence are falsities of evil.
The side () = spiritual love.
The sides of the north () = truths from celestial good.
The sides of Lebanon () = where these (goods) are conjoined with truths.
As thorns in your sides ()...Sides = the things of charity, thus goods.
The house = the spiritual mind; its sides () = all things which are in the natural man.
(The bear) raised itself up on its side () = the cupidity of falsifying the goods of the Word.
The sides of the pit = places in Hell where are mere falsities of evil.
